column8: ["The machine reads as a spread of glossy buttons rather than one weighty kiln-floor object, with little distinctive character in its repeated forms.","The seats have bright lower-right highlights and dark upper-left shading, baking a directional light into a sprite that must rotate freely.","The seat rims and exposed brass have soft, uniform brown shading, lacking the rubbed edges and material variation that would make them feel worked and handled."]
